{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only count each patient once, using their latest test
# Importantly, we do NOT filter out -999 here, because enrolment is defined by presence in the dataset
# Even if a patient has only a QC-failed row, they were enrolled

# First, verify that we're deduplicating correctly
# Group by patient_id and keep the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print the result
print(n_patients)"}
